introduction.text: WASP-12 is a star of 6,265 K 427 parsecs away. Its planet WASP-12 b crosses it, which is how it was found and sized.

sources.quote: WASP-12 has a mass and radius similar to the Sun and is known for being orbited by a planet that is extremely hot and has a retrograde orbit around WASP-12.
